## DevelopFileViewer

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.Coding.Components.Pages`
**Assembly:** `Cyrena.Coding.Extension`
**Route:** `/develop-file-viewer/{FileId}/{KernelId}`

### Purpose
Blazor page for viewing file version history with a Monaco diff editor. Allows reverting to previous versions.

### Parameters
```csharp
[Parameter] public string? KernelId { get; set; }
[Parameter] public string? FileId { get; set; }
```

### Injected Services
```csharp
[Inject] private IKernelController _controller { get; set; } = default!;
[Inject] private NavigationManager _nav { get; set; } = default!;
[Inject] private ToastService _toasts { get; set; } = default!;
[Inject] private IJSRuntime _js { get; set; } = default!;
```

### Features
- Dropdown to select from version history (newest first)
- Monaco diff editor (dark theme, vs-dark)
- **Revert button**: Restores selected version content and rolls back version history
- **Keep button**: Removes backup history and returns to chat

### Version Selection
Versions displayed as: `{Timestamp:MMM d, HH:mm:ss} — {Label}`

### Navigation
- Back button links to `converse/{KernelId}`
- Revert/Keep both navigate back to chat
